name: orgx-live
description: Optional OrgX mod: shows decisions waiting on you in a status line and pane, and, only when you turn capture on, sends OrgX one counts-only summary per turn. Adds function hooks.

capture.title: Send turn summaries to OrgX
capture.description: off sends nothing. summary sends one counts-only summary per turn (tool counts, files changed count, failures, duration); never file contents, prompts, command output or paths.

initiative.title: OrgX initiative for turn summaries
initiative.description: Initiative UUID that captured summaries are attributed to. Leave empty to use the initiative bound by orgx_bootstrap in this session.
